name: PayBySquare
shortDescription: Generates and decodes PayBySquare QR codes for Slovak banking payments with validation and compliance checking.

rawRecord.short_description: Generates and decodes PayBySquare QR codes for Slovak banking payments with validation and compliance checking.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Generates and decodes PayBySquare QR codes following the Slovak national payment standard adopted by the Slovak Banking Association. Provides tools for creating QR codes from payment data, decoding existing QR codes from images, validating payment data against banking standards with detailed error reporting, and verifying round-trip encoding integrity. Built on the bysquare library with IBAN validation support.
